(3) All 1728 CSV rows re-derived from committed chartables.json via exact Fraction inner products: zero mismatches on every valid g6..g10 entry and every empty (invalid-padding) entry. (4) Witness class-sum certificate checked term-by-term: each chi and z matches the committed table, each term equals chi^3/z, and the sums equal 1,8,15,19. (5) Cross-identities confirmed: sum-of-squares 3603 for (6,3,1)^2 and 96237 for (4,3,2,1)^2 at n=10; dimension identity 99225=315^2. (6) Census tallies confirmed: 1669 stabilized-in-window vs 59 increasing-at-10; stab histogram 689/353/465/162; gbar histogram including 663 zeros and max 18; zero trajectories with any strict decrease; 343/343 weight<=3 triples stabilized; 24 triples with 3 strict increases of which 10 are increasing-at-10; range-18 tied-maximal pair ((3,1)^3 increasing, (2,1,1)^3 stabilized 0,8,17,18,18); largest g10 among delayed is 19. DRAFT honestly distinguishes theorem from observation: stab/gbar for stabilized triples mean suffix-constancy through n=10 conditional on Murnaghan eventual-constancy, and delayed triples claim only stab>10 and gbar>=g10. No exact threshold beyond the window is over-claimed.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, verified live: Briand-Orellana-Rosas 0907.4652 computes the exact n where all coefficients of ONE Kronecker product stabilize plus two improved Brion/Vallejo bounds -- a per-product formula, not an exhaustive 1728-triple threshold/stable-value table with maximal-delay witness. Sam-Snowden 1501.00333 proves Stembridge-type stability structurally via Hilbert functions/Schur-Weyl -- no exact small-core thresholds. Ikenmeyer-Panova 2305.03003 proves every ordinary coefficient equals some reduced one with hardness corollaries -- a structural equivalence, not a delay census. These give bounds and theorems plus scattered/single-family values; they do not mechanically imply the per-triple in-window thresholds, the stable-value histogram, or the identity and trajectory of the maximal-delay core (3,1)^3. The scope (all 12 ordered cores of weight<=4, padded sequences across n=6..10) is a natural complete window, not a renamed implementation or database repackaging.

value.rationale: Headline claim judged separately from the surrounding (admittedly window-truncated) census: the certified maximal-delay exact trajectory g((3,3,1)^3)=1 < g((4,3,1)^3)=8 < g((5,3,1)^3)=15 < g((6,3,1)^3)=19, hence stab>10 and reduced value >=19, with every inner product replayed term-by-term, plus the complete 1728-row in-window threshold/stable-value boundary table (1669 stabilized, 59 certified delayed, full monotonicity). The object (Murnaghan-padded Kronecker sequences) and invariant (stabilization thresholds, stable values, maximal delay) were motivated before computation by the recognized Murnaghan/reduced-vs-ordinary dictionary, GCT obstruction-degree estimates, and the stabilization-bounds program; the values are not known or mechanically implied by existing bounds; a future researcher can reasonably need the precise witness, the 59 delayed list, and the exact threshold histogram as boundary/benchmark data. This is an exact invariant of a natural object under the stated standard, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. The incomplete 59-triple tail is described honestly and does not erase the exact headline datum.
